body.text: The "DOJ is not appealing" story was wrong — and the injunction's scope is finally mapped

A DOJ spokesperson told the New York Times the department merely will not request a STAY if and when it appeals — not that it won't appeal. Roughly five weeks of filing window remain and nothing has been filed. Separately, the covered-parties list is now documented from Judge Hendrix's order.

facts.title: 1. DOJ's real appeal posture — no stay, not no appeal
2. Who and what the injunction actually covers
3. Silencer Shop v. ATF — the parent item

body.text:
• Correction: DOJ did not say it is dropping the appeal
• Covered-parties list now public: 7 groups, 4 businesses, 15 states
• Customers covered only for transactions WITH a plaintiff
• Machine guns, destructive devices, dealer taxes: untouched
